scope.description: English-language TCG printings of Monsters (including Fusion and Ritual), Spells and Traps printed in the first 11 TCG booster sets (Legend of Blue Eyes White Dragon to Ancient Sanctuary) or in side products released by Ancient Sanctuary's date, with all of their printings to date.

boosters.set_name: Legend of Blue Eyes White Dragon

cards.name: 3-Hump Lacooda
cards.desc: If there are 3 face-up "3-Hump Lacooda" cards on your side of the field, Tribute 2 of them to draw 3 cards.

cards.name: 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom
cards.desc: FLIP: Destroy all Level 4 monsters your opponent controls.

When there are 3 face-up "7" cards on your side of the field, draw 3 cards from your Deck. Then destroy all "7" cards. When this card is sent directly from the field to your Graveyard, increase your Life Points by 700 points.

cards.name: 7 Colored Fish
cards.desc: A rare rainbow fish that has never been caught by mortal man.

cards.name: 7 Completed
cards.desc: Activate this card by choosing ATK or DEF; equip only to a Machine monster. It gains 700 ATK or DEF, depending on the choice.

cards.name: 8-Claws Scorpion
cards.desc: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card attacks an opponent's face-down Defense Position monster, this card's ATK becomes 2400 during damage calculation only.

cards.name: A Cat of Ill Omen
cards.desc: FLIP: Choose 1 Trap from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck, or, if "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add that Trap to your hand instead.

cards.name: A Deal with Dark Ruler
cards.desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
If a Level 8 or higher monster under your control was sent to the Graveyard this turn: Special Summon 1 "Berserk Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

cards.name: A Feint Plan
cards.desc: A player cannot attack face-down monsters during this turn.

cards.name: A Hero Emerges
cards.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card from your hand, then if it is a monster that can be Special Summoned, Special Summon it. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.

cards.name: A Legendary Ocean
cards.desc:
(This card's name is always treated as "Umi".)
All WATER monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both players' hands and on the field by 1.

cards.name: A Man with Wdjat
cards.desc: When you Normal Summon this card, and during each of your Standby Phases, select 1 Set card on your opponent's side of the field. Pick it up and look at it, then return it to its original position.

cards.name: A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon
cards.desc: Return 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster you control to the hand, and if you do, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

cards.name: Absorbing Kid from the Sky
cards.desc: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase your Life Points by the Level of the destroyed monster x 300 points.

cards.name: Acid Trap Hole
cards.desc: Target 1 face-down Defense Position monster on the field; flip it face-up, then destroy it if its DEF is 2000 or less, or return it face-down if its DEF is more than 2000.

cards.name: Acrobat Monkey
cards.desc: An autonomous monkey type robot which was developed with cutting-edge technology. It moves very acrobatically.

cards.name: Adhesion Trap Hole
cards.desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

cards.name: After the Struggle
cards.desc: This card can only be activated during Main Phase 1. All monsters on both sides of the field that have been involved in damage calculation are destroyed during the End Step of the turn.

cards.name: Agido
cards.desc: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, roll a six-sided die. You can Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your Graveyard whose Level is equal to the number rolled. (If the result is 6, you can Special Summon a Level 6 or higher monster.)

cards.name: Airknight Parshath
cards.desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Aitsu
cards.desc: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

cards.name: Alpha The Magnet Warrior
cards.desc: ''Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.''

cards.name: Altar for Tribute
cards.desc: Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send it to the Graveyard. Increase your Life Points by an amount equal to the original ATK of the monster.

cards.name: Amazoness Archer
cards.desc: You can Tribute 2 monsters; inflict 1200 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Amazoness Archers
cards.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack, while you control an "Amazoness" monster: Change all monsters your opponent currently controls to face-up Attack Position (Flip Effects are not activated), they lose 500 ATK, also they must attack this turn, if able.

cards.name: Amazoness Blowpiper
cards.desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls during each of your Standby Phases. It loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Amazoness Fighter
cards.desc: You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card.

cards.name: Amazoness Paladin
cards.desc: This card gains 100 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control.

cards.name: Amazoness Spellcaster
cards.desc: Target 1 "Amazoness" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; switch the original ATK of those targets until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Amazoness Swords Woman
cards.desc: Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card instead.

cards.name: Amazoness Tiger
cards.desc: You can only control 1 "Amazoness Tiger". This card gains 400 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control. Your opponent cannot attack any face-up "Amazoness" monsters, except this one.

cards.name: Ameba
cards.desc: When the control of this face-up card on the field shifts to your opponent, inflict 2000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. This effect can only be used once as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

cards.name: Amphibian Beast
cards.desc: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

cards.name: Amphibious Bugroth MK-3
cards.desc: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

cards.name: Amplifier
cards.desc: Equip only to "Jinzo". While this card is equipped, the equipped monster's effect does not negate the effects of its controller's Trap Cards. When this card is removed from the field, destroy the equipped monster. This card's activation and effect cannot be negated.

cards.name: An Owl of Luck
cards.desc: FLIP: Select 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck. If "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add the selected Field Spell Card to your hand instead.

cards.name: Ancient Brain
cards.desc: A fallen fairy that is powerful in the dark.

cards.name: Ancient Elf
cards.desc: This elf is rumored to have lived for thousands of years. He leads an army of spirits against his enemies.

cards.name: Ancient Lizard Warrior
cards.desc: Before the dawn of man, this lizard warrior ruled supreme.

cards.name: Ancient One of the Deep Forest
cards.desc: This creature adopts the form of a white goat living in the forest, but is actually a Forest Elder.

cards.name: Ancient Telescope
cards.desc: See the top 5 cards of your opponent's Deck. Return the cards to the Deck in the same order.

cards.name: Ansatsu
cards.desc: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

cards.name: Ante
cards.desc: Each Player reveals 1 card from their hand. If one card is higher Level than the other, the card with the lower Level is sent to the Graveyard, and the player who revealed it takes 1000 damage. (Non-Monster Cards are treated as Level 0.)

cards.name: Anti Raigeki
cards.desc: When your opponent activates "Raigeki": Negate its effect, and if you do, destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

cards.name: Anti-Aircraft Flower
cards.desc: By Tributing 1 Insect-Type monster on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Anti-Spell
cards.desc: Remove 2 Spell Counters on your side of the field to negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it.

cards.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
cards.desc: Both players must Set Spell Cards before activating them, and cannot activate them until their next turn after Setting them.

cards.name: Apprentice Magician
cards.desc: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. If this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

cards.name: Appropriate
cards.desc: Activate only when your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase. After that, each time your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase, immediately draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Aqua Chorus
cards.desc: If there are monsters with the same name on the field, increase the ATK and DEF of all of those monsters with the same name by 500 points.

cards.name: Aqua Madoor
cards.desc: A wizard of the waters that conjures a liquid wall to crush any enemies that oppose him.

cards.name: Aqua Spirit
cards.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WATER monster in your Graveyard. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, you can change the battle position of 1 of your opponent's face-up Monster Cards. Once changed, the monster must remain in this position for the rest of the turn.

cards.name: Arcane Archer of the Forest
cards.desc: While there is a Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, this card cannot be attacked. By Tributing 1 Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

cards.name: Archfiend Soldier
cards.desc: An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.

cards.name: Archfiend's Oath
cards.desc: Once per turn: You can pay 500 Life Points, then declare 1 card name; excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Archfiend's Roar
cards.desc: Pay 500 Life Points, then target 1 "Archfiend" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. It cannot be Tributed. Destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

cards.name: Archlord Zerato
cards.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on your side of the field, by discarding 1 LIGHT Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

cards.name: Armaill
cards.desc: A strange warrior who manipulates three deadly blades with both hands and his tail.

cards.name: Armed Ninja
cards.desc: FLIP: Target 1 Spell Card on the field; destroy that target. (If the target is Set, reveal it, and destroy it if it is a Spell Card. Otherwise, return it to its original position.)

cards.name: Armor Break
cards.desc: Negate the activation of an Equip Spell Card and destroy it.

cards.name: Armor Exe
cards.desc: This card cannot attack in the same turn it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned. During each of your and your opponent's Standby Phases, remove 1 Spell Counter on your side of the field. If you do not, destroy this card.

cards.name: Armored Glass
cards.desc: You can only activate this card when a monster is equipped with an Equip Card. Negate the effects of all Equip Cards on the field during the turn this card is activated.

cards.name: Armored Lizard
cards.desc: A lizard with a very tough hide and a vicious bite.

cards.name: Armored Starfish
cards.desc: A bluish starfish with a solid hide capable of fending off attacks.

cards.name: Armored Zombie
cards.desc: This warrior blindly swings a deadly blade with devastating force.

cards.name: Array of Revealing Light
cards.desc: Declare 1 Type of monster. Any monster of the declared Type cannot declare an attack during the turn it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Special Summoned.

cards.desc: Your opponent selects 1 Equip Spell Card from his/her Deck and sends it to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Arsenal Summoner
cards.desc: FLIP: Add 1 "Guardian" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Celtic Guardian", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #2", "Guardian of the Labyrinth", or "The Reliable Guardian".

cards.name: Asura Priest

cards.name: Autonomous Action Unit
cards.desc: Pay 1500 Life Points, then target 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon that target to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

cards.name: Avatar of The Pot
cards.desc: By sending 1 "Pot of Greed" from your hand to the Graveyard, draw 3 cards from your Deck.

cards.name: Axe Raider
cards.desc: An axe-wielding monster of tremendous strength and agility.

cards.name: Baby Dragon
cards.desc: Much more than just a child, this dragon is gifted with untapped power.

cards.name: Bait Doll

cards.name: Balloon Lizard
cards.desc: Put 1 counter on this card during each of your Standby Phases. When this card is destroyed, inflict damage to the controller of the card that destroyed it equal to the number of counters X 400 points.

cards.name: Banisher of the Light
cards.desc: Any card sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.

cards.name: Banner of Courage
cards.desc: All monsters you control gain 200 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

cards.desc: If a Fiend-Type monster you control battles, during the Damage Step: Pay LP (in multiples of 100 points), then target the opponent's battling monster; that opponent's monster loses that much ATK and DEF, until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Baron of the Fiend Sword
cards.desc: An aristocrat who wields a sword possessed by a malicious spirit that preys on the weak.

cards.name: Barrel Behind the Door
cards.desc: Activate only when a card's effect that would inflict damage to you is activated. Your opponent takes the damage instead.

cards.name: Battle-Scarred
cards.desc: Select 1 Archfiend monster on your side of the field to activate this card. Your opponent also pays the same Life Points that you pay for the selected monster during the Standby Phase. If this card is removed from the field, destroy the selected monster. When the selected monster is removed from the field, destroy this card.

cards.name: Berserk Gorilla
cards.desc: If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy this card. This card must attack if able.

cards.name: Beta The Magnet Warrior

cards.name: Bickuribox

"Summoned Skull" + "Red-Eyes Black Dragon"
